The '''Icicle''' was, along with the [[Cliffside]], one of the two [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]] in [[Elesa]], the small capital city of [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]], at some point before [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].<ref name="g2" />
